name: Smoked Salmon & Scrambled Eggs on Sourdough
description: Soft buttery scrambled eggs and smoked salmon piled over toasted sourdough, finished with chives, black pepper and fresh lemon.
instructions: Toast the sourdough until golden and crisp.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, season lightly with salt and beat until combined.
Melt 10 g butter in a non-stick pan over medium-low heat. Add the eggs and cook gently, stirring and folding continuously until softly scrambled and still slightly glossy.
Remove from the heat and stir through the remaining 5 g butter.
Place the toast on a plate and spoon the scrambled eggs over it.
Fold the smoked salmon loosely over the eggs.
Finish with chopped chives, black pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
